name: Paradise Road Play Area
text: Children's play equipment on Writtle Parish Council's Paradise Road sports field in Writtle, alongside basketball hoops, a skate strip and an outdoor table tennis table.

name: Oxney Green Park Playground
text: Writtle Parish Council's playground at Oxney Green Park, Oxney Green near Writtle, in a park that also has basketball hoops, an outdoor gym and a petanque court.
